description:
## What

New workspace crate `pkix-pkilint-bridge`. Std-only. Sibling of pkix-zlint-bridge (PKIX-jy95.7); provides the same shape for pkilint (Python, DigiCert; strong on S/MIME BR and ETSI).

## Scope

Same shape as PKIX-jy95.7 but for pkilint:

- Subprocess spawn (pkilint CLI on PATH or configured Python invocation)
- Stdout parsing (pkilint's output format)
- Verdict vocabulary normalization
- BridgeError type
- Single-cert and batch entry points
- Test fixtures sourced from pkilint's own test corpus

## Consumed by

- `pkix-policy-pkilint` (PKIX-jy95.2 area conceptually, parallel to zlint adapter) — runtime adapter
- `pkix-difftest`'s pkilint oracle (PKIX-hbzo.1) — differential testing

## Cross-references

- PKIX-jy95.6 (decision that filed this crate)
- PKIX-jy95.7 (parallel pkix-zlint-bridge — implement similar shape)
- PKIX-hbzo.1 (consumer; differential oracle)
- AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6

## Open shape decisions

- Python subprocess invocation: `pkilint` CLI directly, or `python -m pkilint ...`, or PyO3? Subprocess preferred per PKIX-jy95.6 / Mark 2026-05-12 — no in-process Python.
- pkilint's output format: JSON when --format json is supplied? Verify.
- pkilint version pinning + lint-module organization (cabf_serverauth / cabf_smime / etsi).
- Whether to share any abstractions with pkix-zlint-bridge or keep them independent (probably keep independent — verdict vocabularies and parsing details differ enough).

## Local install status

Unlike zlint (installed locally via PKIX-amgn.8.1), pkilint is NOT yet installed locally. PKIX-hbzo.1 description says install would be via 'pip install pkilint' or vendored Python script under pkix-difftest/python/. Implementation work here will likely require a parallel 'install pkilint locally' setup bead.

## Out of scope

- Implementing pkix-policy-pkilint (separate bead).
- pkilint contribution / patches upstream.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Crate exists in workspace Cargo.toml as a published library
- [ ] Subprocess plumbing with configurable pkilint invocation
- [ ] Output parsing for pkilint's findings format
- [ ] Verdict normalization to bridge-shaped Verdict enum
- [ ] BridgeError satisfies non-negotiable #6
- [ ] Single-cert + batch entry points
- [ ] Cargo feature 'serde' enables Serialize/Deserialize derives
- [ ] Test fixtures cite their pkilint test source
- [ ] CHANGELOG + AGENTS.md inventory entry
title: Create pkix-pkilint-bridge crate (shared subprocess + parsing infrastructure for pkilint)
